strategies.name: Detection Strategy for T1497 Virtualization/Sandbox Evasion

analytics.name: Analytic 0127
analytics.guidance: Execution of discovery commands or API calls for virtualization artifacts (e.g., registry keys, device drivers, services), sleep/skipped execution behavior, or sandbox evasion DLLs before payload deployment.

tuning.description: Time range in which multiple discovery processes or sleep/delay operations are executed to avoid sandbox detonation.
Registry paths, DLLs, services or device names indicative of sandbox/VM environments.

analytics.name: Analytic 0128
analytics.guidance: Execution of commands to enumerate virtualization-related files or processes (e.g., '/sys/class/dmi/id/product_name', dmesg, lscpu, lspci), or querying hypervisor interfaces prior to malware execution.

tuning.description: Duration between VM discovery commands and payload execution
Command-line regex patterns indicative of sandbox evasion (e.g., grep QEMU, strings vmware)

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: execve or syscall invoking vm artifact check commands (e.g., dmidecode, lspci, dmesg)

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: sleep function usage or loops (nanosleep, usleep) in scripts

analytics.name: Analytic 0129
analytics.guidance: Execution of scripts or binaries that check for virtualization indicators (e.g., system_profiler, ioreg -l, kextstat), combined with delay functions or anomalous launchd activity.

tuning.description: Detection regex or substring matching sandbox-related checks
Maximum duration of sleep execution before alert (e.g., > 5 minutes)

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: execution of system_profiler, ioreg, kextstat with argument patterns related to VM/sandbox checks

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: dynamic loading of sleep-related functions or sandbox detection libraries
